title: Member Extension Requests on a Prior Authorization
content:
A Prairie Ridge member who needs an approved Prior Authorization to continue past its end date may file an extension request in person. The request states the additional units asked for and the end date asked for. The end date asked for is the authorization's current end date moved forward by the class's extension days.

## Clause

1. A member who needs an approved authorization to continue past its end date may file the extension request in person, on the authorization it concerns, stating the additional units asked for and the end date asked for.
2. The end date asked for is the current end date of the authorization moved forward by the extension days of the authorization's Prior Authorization class.
3. The units an extension request asks for are worked out only once the authorization names, as its servicing provider, the provider who will deliver the extended units.

Clause 3 in the terms the authorization record shows: while the servicing provider named on the authorization is not the provider who will deliver the extended units, the units of the extension request are not yet worked out.

## Illustration of clause 2 (hypothetical)

| Current end date | Class extension days | End date asked for |
|---|---|---|
| 2031-03-10 | 60 | 2031-05-09 |
| 2031-03-10 | 14 | 2031-03-24 |

## Invocation: `file_extension_request_1d826295`

**Situation of use and capability.** The tool files, dated the day it is run, one extension request made by the member on one of the member's approved (or recently ended) Prior Authorization authorizations, stating the additional units asked for and the end date asked for. The member then sees the extension request on the authorization's history.

**How it is invoked.** This is the member's own tool. The agent unlocks `file_extension_request_1d826295` and hands it over; the customer themselves runs it.

**Parameters.**

- `authorization_id` — the reference number of the member's Prior Authorization the extension is asked for, as the agent reads it to the member from the prior authorization records. Text identifier.
- `requested_units` — the additional units the member asks for, in the authorization's unit basis, written as whole integer units.
- `requested_end_date` — the end date the member asks the authorization to run to, written as a calendar date in the format YYYY-MM-DD.

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `authorization_id` | authorization the extension is asked for | reference number |
| `requested_units` | additional units asked for | whole integer units |
| `requested_end_date` | end date asked for | YYYY-MM-DD |

**Return.** A confirmation sentence stating the extension request reference (an identifier beginning with `aac_`), the authorization reference, the whole number of units asked for, the end date asked for (YYYY-MM-DD) and the date filed (YYYY-MM-DD, the day it is run). The presence of the extension request reference shows that the request was filed.
